content: Transformer-based models enriched with image information (base+sum, base+att and base+obj), on the other hand, show no major improvements with respect to the base performance. This is also the case for deliberation models with image information (del+sum, del+att, del+obj), which do not show significant improvement over the vanilla deliberation performance (del).
